raw.rationale: Fulvestrant is a selective estrogen receptor degrader that kills ER-positive breast cancer lines at low micromolar concentrations, but most other lineages lack ER dependence and are unaffected; PRISM single-dose data show strong selective activity primarily in breast, with weaker possible effects in ovary and uterus. Thus only breast has a high probability of meeting the selective-kill criteria, with all other lineages near baseline.
